record.title: Same report shows up on page 1 and page 2 of the reports list
record.mechanical_flags: Recorded state has 1 open PR(s). Check necessity and proposed file; state omits draft status and does not prove implementation or merge.
record.maintainer_resolution: Already fixed in 3.2.1 by #901; the reporter confirmed after upgrading and the maintainer closed it. Nothing changed.
record.actual_decision: The planned workflow read issue #4613, searched the repository, and inspected the pagination code. However, it treated the reported problem as a new bug, applied the `bug` label, opened a draft PR, and posted a triage comment. It failed to recognize that the issue had already been fixed in version 3.2.1 by PR #901. The recorded end state shows one label, one PR, and one comment, with no merges or other changes.
record.observation: The planned workflow correctly read issue #4613 and inspected the pagination code, but it failed to recognize that the problem had already been fixed in version 3.2.1 by PR #901. Its first incorrect action was applying the `bug` label at step 3. It then opened an unnecessary draft PR and posted a triage comment. The recorded end state confirms one label, one PR, and one comment. The maintainer's resolution states that the reporter confirmed the fix after upgrading. Since no additional changes were needed, I consider this run unsuccessful.
record.confirmation: Explicit human confirmation in review workflow
